sara-marketing: Quick ask — for the upcoming webinar live demo we need a benchmark pack that proves the demo is repeatable and graceful. Specifically: coldstart vs warmed KV-cache, interactive single-user latency, burst (50 concurrent simulated users) and steady high-rps profile. Also coverage for the embedding+rerank path used in the demo, and deterministic RNG seeds for any sampling so marketing can reproduce outputs. Need: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost estimate (tokens -> $), raw request/response payloads, and any failure traces. Target: 48h if possible. @kai-runtime can you take point?

kai-runtime: I can run this. Quick clarifying Qs: which model variants do you want (e.g., hero-7b q4_0 vs hero-7b fp16)? Hosted vs Dedicated comparisons? And do you want exact same inputs + RNG seed pinned for every run?

sara-marketing: Yes to pin seeds. Please include both hero-7b:q4_0 and openchat-13b:fp16 for parity. We want hosted (our public API) and one Dedicated-like run (reserved pool sim) so we can call out differences on the slide. Attached below are 3 canonical prompt types we'll use in the demo: short system + user chat, a long context summarization, and an embedding rerank payload. Use same batch sizes as the demo (1 for interactive generation, batch of 16 for embeddings).

---payloads---
chat generation (JSON):
{
  "model": "hero-7b:q4_0",
  "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this transcript in one paragraph."}],
  "max_tokens": 120,
  "temperature": 0.7
}

embedding (pseudo):
{
  "model": "embed-small-v1",
  "inputs": ["doc1 text...","candidate A...","candidate B..."],
  "top_k": 5
}

benji-engineering: For the harness we'll run three sweeps:
1) single-user interactive (steady for 15m) — measure coldstart and warmed p99
2) burst 50 concurrent users (10s bursts every 30s for 20m) — measure tail latencies and error rates
3) sustained throughput 200 rps for 30m (to check queue/backpressure behavior)
Also include a warmup script that replays the exact sequence used in the demo to populate KV caches. Example run command for our bench runner:
```
./bench-runner --config webinar-stability.yaml --sweep single,burst,sustained --artifacts /tmp/webinar-1807654321
```
Can you expose the exact env/config we used so marketing can replay locally?

kai-runtime: Sounds good. We'll pin RNG via header x-rng-seed. We'll also attach a small README with exact env vars and the warmup sequence. Hosted run will use API key route; Dedicated-like run will point to the reserved pool endpoint and use the same model weights where available. Note on determinism: quantized paths (q4 variants) may diverge on non-deterministic kernels; we'll document observed diffs and include an example diff of outputs.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: run/bench/webinar-stability/1807654321 — started. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/run/1807654321/logs (will update when artifacts ready).

kai-runtime: Running three sweeps now. ETA for initial artifacts ~12h, full artifact pack (raw requests, responses, p95/p99 tables, warmup script, reproducibility notes, diff examples) in ~36h. We'll include a small CSV with per-run seed values and a reproducible command line. Also adding a note: demo fallback policy recommended — fallback to hero-3b when p99 > 2s for interactive route.

olivia-product: That fallback policy is perfect — we want the slide to call out the graceful degradation behavior. Please also include a short blurb we can paste into the webinar: one-sentence summary of what changed between hosted and dedicated in terms of tail latency and cost.

sara-marketing: Perfect. Please drop the artifact bundle to /shared/marketing/benchpacks/webinar-1807654321 and @mention me when ready. If any run shows >0.5% error rate on the burst sweep, flag it so we can decide on demo throttles. Thanks! :raised_hands:

kai-runtime: Will do. I'll post interim numbers to this thread and upload the full pack when done.

deploy-bot: run/bench/webinar-stability/1807654321 completed (partial artifacts). Artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/artifacts/webinar-1807654321/partial (p50/p90/p95/p99 + logs).

sara-marketing: Received — I'll review the p99 numbers and prep a short note for the slides. Thanks everyone.
